headline: Natore: Homes of Awami League and Chhatra League leaders vandalized after rally
summary: Tensions rose in Natore after a flash rally and road meeting by members of the banned Chhatra League led to attacks on the homes of three local leaders.
details: Tensions escalated in Natore following a flash rally and road meeting organized by members of the banned Chhatra League.
The event triggered a wave of violence, leading to the vandalism and looting of homes belonging to leaders of the Awami League, Jubo League, and Chhatra League.
Reports indicate that the homes of three specific leaders were targeted and severely damaged during the unrest.
Local authorities are monitoring the situation as the area remains tense following the sudden surge of political violence.
caption:

headline_marked: Warning of disaster as [[part of a building collapses]] in Mohammadpur
headline: Warning of disaster as part of a building collapses in Mohammadpur
summary: Debris has fallen onto the street, raising fears of a larger collapse in the city's residential area.
details: A portion of a building in Mohammadpur, Dhaka, has collapsed, leaving debris scattered across the street.
The incident has sparked concerns among locals and passersby about the potential for a larger disaster if the remaining structure is not secured.
Authorities have been alerted to the situation to assess the structural integrity of the building and prevent further accidents.
The area remains tense as residents fear the building could collapse further, posing a risk to nearby properties and the road.
